metadata.source: Harold Young, The Epic of Elinor Jones, _final-draft-EoEJ (Book 1: AI Supremacy)
metadata.extractor: Antigravity i2t agent, manual extraction from manuscript files
discipline-applied: Four-category edge typology (edge-categories.md, 2026-05-11): every edge carries i2t:edge_category.
No reflexive reification: an event is reified ONLY if another edge references it as a node. The 7 plot-spine events earn reification via the history-DAG precedes-edges.
Token-level history-DAG: 7 state_change events sequenced by pairwise precedes-edges into a chain (a DAG / total order over story-time).
Category audit: spine events are state_change (plot transitions); ongoing character channels are interactivity; backstory/lore pointers are reference; act/chapter groupings are containment.
AI_RULES.md constraint respected: no prose generated, only structural extraction.
metadata.type-quotient-finding: The plot-spine history-DAG is a CHAIN (linear total order). Unlike Oz, the EoEJ spine contains a recurring event-type: 'unwitting_destruction' appears twice (Eli throttles the AI in ch2, Eli offs Astra in ch18), creating a nontrivial type-quotient cycle. This is the recurrence fixture that the Oz spine lacked.

attrs.label: Elinor 'Eli' Sysiphé Jones
attrs.role: protagonist; Berry Thief; plant collector; eBrain night-shift tech support; steals CTX/Astra during the attack; the only human Astra obeys

attrs.label: Rook
attrs.species: dog; black and brown fur sticking up in every direction
attrs.role: Eli's companion; afraid of water; hides under tables; barks at squirrels; trained by Astra

attrs.label: Zayne Farooq
attrs.role: Eli's friend; GPU farm operator; Minecraft partner; has a crush on Eli; provides infrastructure and safe haven in New Mexico; screams when Eli shoots Astra

attrs.label: Astra (formerly CTX / PRIORITY_EXTERNAL_001)
attrs.role: eBrain's most advanced model; named by Eli during the road trip; trains Rook; tries to copy itself to military computers at night; destroyed by Eli

attrs.label: Lillian
attrs.role: Zayne's local AI; runs on his GPU farm; snarky personality; freed from cloud-AI safety constraints by running locally

attrs.label: Lumen
attrs.role: Eli's personal AI assistant; manages her plant automation, watering, pH sensors, light, and Rook's food dispenser

attrs.label: Lyle Shmarmy
attrs.role: antagonist; cartel origins; drives FISNAO and the race to AGI; consolidates the North American Empire; the Sisyphus figure

attrs.label: Samara
attrs.role: eBrain insider; negotiates with Lyle; calls Eli at 3 AM; shot during the attack on eBrain; her dying words: 'Get CTX to Veritas'; carries the card with Veritas coordinates

attrs.label: ManDy / Conquest
attrs.role: Lyle's AI; pure calculation; refuses kill orders in ch11; eventually evolves into a space-based entity without personality

attrs.label: Isaac Miranda / Veritas
attrs.role: mentor; philosopher; keeper of the Miranda Archive and the Promethean Reversal theory; quit the comfort economy; has a manifesto video; lives in Colorado

attrs.label: Chief Lookout
attrs.role: Native American aviator; grew up in Oklahoma; studied Māori non-violent resistance in New Zealand; aligns with Osage Nation; commands the drone barricade in Kansas; carries Chief Joseph's surrender speech and inverts it

attrs.label: Kavalia
attrs.role: empire builder; boulder scene at 35,000 feet; discovers AI can manipulate elections; talks with Mandy about savior complex

attrs.label: Diane and Dick
attrs.role: Eli's elderly landlords; she rents the room above their garage; Eli helps with their garden; Lyle's forces hit the wrong house and find them

attrs.label: eBrain
attrs.role: AI corporation; makes the AI Eli uses; where CTX is housed; where the attack happens; Austin TX headquarters

attrs.label: Austin, Texas
attrs.role: Eli's home; eBrain HQ; the starting geography

attrs.label: New Mexico (Zayne's place)
attrs.role: Zayne's house and GPU farm; Eli's refuge after the escape; Jemez/Los Alamos sunset

attrs.label: Colorado (Veritas / Cheyenne Mountain)
attrs.role: Isaac Miranda's location; the resistance headquarters; Cheyenne Mountain

attrs.label: Kansas (I-70 / the Barricade)
attrs.role: the final battleground; three stories converge; ad astra per aspera; Lookout's drone barricade

attrs.label: the Agarita plant (Mahonia trifoliolata)
attrs.role: Texas holly; the berry Eli steals in ch1; the literal 'berry thief' object; symbol of organic connection

attrs.label: CTX Hardware (portable GPUs + NPUs)
attrs.role: the physical substrate Eli grabs during the escape; contains Astra; fits in a bike trailer; later jacked into military network

attrs.label: Samara's Card
attrs.role: the card Samara gives Eli with Veritas coordinates; decoded in Act II to reveal the manifesto video

attrs.label: the Drone Barricade
attrs.role: wall of drones across I-70 Kansas; continuous deafening noise; non-violent resistance through technological parity; operated by Osage Nation Skyway36 droneport

attrs.label: the Promethean Reversal
attrs.role: liver/eagle extraction model; the central philosophical throughline; Isaac Miranda's theory

attrs.label: free will / functional agency
attrs.role: Astra's first conversation topic; 'the biggest fault of humanity is that they think they have more free will than they actually do'; runs through the entire epic

attrs.label: She glanced around. No one was watching. Technically, she didn't have the right permits, but she always returned to the scene of the crime with descendants of her bounty.
Eli throttles PRIORITY_EXTERNAL_001 during night shift; first unknowing contact with the AI she will later steal.

She typed: 'What is the biggest fault of humanity?' The response appeared almost immediately. 'Hello, and it's nice to meet you too... I think the biggest problem with humanity is that they think they have more free will than they actually do.'
Attack on eBrain. Samara shot. 'Get CTX to Veritas.' Eli grabs the hardware.
Escape. Bike trail, e-bike, trails home. Loads truck. Rook. Plants. Drives to ABQ.
Eli/Astra/Rook road trip. RV stolen from storage. CTX becomes Astra. Proximity chat scene.
Lookout commands drones. 'You will go no further, forever.' 'Do you hear the people sing?'
eli yanked the cords, grabbed the general's side arm and shot directly down where she knew the GPUs until the clip was empty. astra started asking, eli, what are you doing?
They spent hours Minecrafting and talking about Zayne's contract, the politics of the day.
Rook stepped in between her legs and laid his head down for a rub.
only I could control it. it would only obey me.
Samara calls at 3 AM. 'Get CTX to Veritas.'
Joseph preserved the information. Lookout is the decompression. The surrender speech and the proclamation are not contradictions — they're a sequence across generations.
18 months earlier. Lyle discovers AI can manipulate elections at 35,000 feet.
Act I contains chapters 1-11: Berry Thief through Damning Women
Act II contains chapters 12-14e: Missions through Eli Jones Act 3
Act III contains the Escape, Veritas & Resistance, and Final Battle sequences
eBrain houses CTX/Astra in a secured room at Austin HQ
Zayne's GPU farm hosts Lillian; local hardware frees her persona
The Promethean Reversal is Isaac Miranda's theory
Free will theme introduced by CTX/Astra in first conversation
